question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is: **early**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"early"** refers to something happening or done before the usual or expected time. (जल्दी)

 
 
• **Example:** He woke up early to prepare for his exam.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that such a man is content with himself and gets up early in the morning.
 
• Hence, the term **"early"** is appropriate in the context where something needs to be done before the usual time.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **early**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Late** (देर से): Occurring, coming, or being after the usual or proper time.

 
 
• **Example:** She arrived late to the meeting and missed the initial discussions.
 
 
 
• **Active** (सक्रिय): Engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very active in community service projects.
 
 
 
• **Idle** (निष्क्रिय): Not active or in use; without purpose or effect; pointless.
 
 
• **Example:** The factory has been idle for months due to a lack of orders.
